subject: Mutual Action Plan: Procurement activation pathway / Ariba & Coupa handoff
messages:
From: Ava Simmons <ava.simmons@clearvista.io>
To: rafael.mendes@redwood.ai
Cc: jordan.lee@clearvista.io
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up & procurement path after today's demo

Rafael,

Thank you for the demo this morning — ClearVista's GTM team was excited by the latency wins you showed. I wanted to follow up specifically on procurement so we can get an internal MAP (mutual action plan) spun up and keep timelines tight.

High level from our end:
- Procurement requires completed vendor enrollment (Ariba preferred, Coupa acceptable)
- We need a signed SOW or commercial attachment plus vendor W-9 and banking details for ACH
- Typical internal SLA is 3–4 weeks from ticket creation to activation if paperwork is complete

Can you send a draft MAP with milestones, owners, and a target close date? Jordan and I will workshop with procurement.

Best,
Ava Simmons
Senior Program Manager, Partnerships
ClearVista

Attachments: none

From: rafael.mendes@redwood.ai
To: Ava Simmons <ava.simmons@clearvista.io>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 13 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up & procurement path after today's demo

Ava — thanks for the clear ask and great meeting. I attached a one‑page MAP draft and a vendor onboarding checklist that maps Ariba/Coupa steps to our internal tasks. Key highlights in the MAP:

- Target close date: 2027-06-08 (3 weeks buffer to allow procurement review)
- Milestone 1 (by 2027-05-18): ClearVista returns completed vendor form + W-9 (owner: ClearVista)
- Milestone 2 (by 2027-05-20): Redwood sends commercial attachment / SOW for signature (owner: Redwood - Rafael)
- Milestone 3 (by 2027-05-24): ClearVista completes Ariba supplier enrollment or submits Coupa details (owner: ClearVista procurement)
- Milestone 4 (by 2027-05-31): Payment terms & ACH bank verification complete (owner: ClearVista finance)
- Milestone 5 (by 2027-06-08): Endpoint activation and smoke test (owner: Redwood - Ben)

Dependencies / risks called out in the sheet: Ariba onboarding often requires DUNS + bank verification paperwork; if ClearVista prefers Coupa that shortens procurement lane but adds mapping work on our side. If the W-9 is delayed, the target slips by 2–3 weeks.

I've included the MAP as "Redwood_MAP_v1.0.xlsx" and a vendor onboarding form template. Ben — looping you for the activation SLOs and the smoke test owner. Marissa — please confirm whether we should propose net‑45 or net‑30 in the commercial attachment for this customer.

Next steps: Ava/Jordan — please confirm ownership of Milestones 1 & 3 and upload the W-9 when you have it. If you want us to start a DocuSign flow for the commercial attachment, say the word.

Cheers,
Rafael Mendes
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0193

Attachments:
- Redwood_MAP_v1.0.xlsx (spreadsheet)
- Vendor_Onboarding_Form_Ariba.docx (docx)

From: ben.carter@redwood.ai
To: rafael.mendes@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up & procurement path after today's demo

Thanks Raf — I can own Milestone 5 for the activation and smoke test. A couple of operational notes to include in the MAP:

- For Ariba: we require a P-Card or PO reference plus DUNS in the enrollment; our onboarding template requests an estimated QPS and expected daily token volume to pre-provision capacity on Dedicated if requested.
- For Coupa: we often accept the vendor CSV if Coupa team provides it; however, Coupa sometimes defers bank verification to finance which slows ACH setup.
- Security/compliance ask: procurement will request SOC 2 Type II and our data handling summary. I'll attach the SOC pointer doc to the HubSpot deal page.

I recommend we propose net-30 standard; net-45 is OK if they need longer, but for activation it's better to aim for net-30. Marissa — can you prepare a short commercial attachment that calls out the trial/activation credits and the proposed net-30 payment term?

Ben Carter
Head of Customer Ops, Redwood Inference

Attachment: none (will add SOC doc to HubSpot)

From: Ava Simmons <ava.simmons@clearvista.io>
To: rafael.mendes@redwood.ai
Cc: jordan.lee@clearvista.io, procurement@clearvista.io
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up & procurement path after today's demo

Rafael — apologies for the brief delay. Per procurement's checklist:

- Attached: ClearVista_W-9.pdf (signed)
- Attached: Preliminary bank verification (screenshot of ACH enrollment, will follow with bank letter)
- Jordan will submit the Ariba supplier registration today (we're using Ariba for new vendors)

We agree to net-30 for initial term. Please start the DocuSign for the commercial attachment; we'll route through legal but expect approval within 2–3 business days.

A quick question: who at Redwood will be the point contact for Ariba enrollment questions (they sometimes route to the account technical contact)? Should Jordan loop Ben or Rafael?

Thanks — attaching W-9 now.

—
Ava Simmons
Senior Program Manager, Partnerships
ClearVista
